shortBio.en: Rolling Stones drummer from 1963; jazz-informed pocket behind the guitars.
shortBio.zh: 1963 年起 Rolling Stones 鼓手；爵士语汇的 pocket 托住吉他。

body.en:
Born 1941, London. Joins the Stones in 1963. Drum feel stays closer to jazz pocket than hard-rock blast.

Dies 2021. Core studio and tour drummer for nearly six decades.
body.zh:
1941 年生于伦敦。1963 年加入 Stones。鼓感更近爵士 pocket，而非硬摇轰击。

2021 年去世。近六十年核心录音与巡演鼓手。
